newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Bourse lifts Jeronimo Martins suspension.
newsitem.headline: Bourse lifts Jeronimo Martins suspension.

text.p: The Lisbon bourse lifted a suspension on share trade in retailer Jeronimo Martins, imposed earlier on Thursday, a stock exchange spokesman said.
The suspension was due to a press report that had since been clarified, the spokesman said without giving any details.

The report in the Diario Economico detailed a proposed capital call which the group had announced earlier in the summer. Traders said there appeared to be nothing new in the story and were surprised at the suspension.
Jeronimo Martins has yet to fix a date for the capital call which is to double its share capital to some 27 billion escudos.
